UPS Appoints Bernard Jiang President of Asia Pacific Region

United Parcel Service (UPS) has appointed Bernard Jiang as the new President of its Asia Pacific (APAC) region. Jiang will be responsible for overseeing UPS's operations and strategic growth across the diverse and dynamic Asia Pacific market. The company has not provided further details regarding the specific strategic initiatives Jiang will lead or the exact timeline for his transition into the role.
